statements.notes: Doctor's Best French Red Wine Grape Extract contains BioVin Advanced, made with quality grape extracts from France. This full spectrum extract contains beneficial phytochemicals found in the whole grape. These compounds such as anthocyanins, proanthocyanidins, trans-resveratrol, polyphenols are widely known for their antioxidant properties that contribute to positive effects on cardiovascular health and collagen elasticity. Each capsule of French Red Wine Grape Extract provides the resveratrol equivalent of 3 glasses of red wine.

Helps support healthy cardiovascular function
Helps support healthy aging
Helps support the body's antioxidant potential
Helps maintain collagen elasticity
